Resolves #21183

Replaces the random word filler in `examples/grid/contentSizedRows` with 10,000 deterministic records containing realistic, coherent customer support desk scenarios for a fictional SaaS product across 8 topic areas, 16 scenarios, and 3 length tiers.

Adds a visible proof-line caption (`Label`) below the toolbar:
- Content-sized mode: "10,000 rows, each as tall as its text."
- Fixed-height mode: "Fixed-height rows clip overflowing text."

The caption updates dynamically with the existing toggle and remains visible on desktop and mobile viewports with zero horizontal overflow.

The changes also fix URL-based theme initialization (`?theme=`) and resolve fixed-height row rendering by introducing an example-scoped stylesheet (`MainContainer.css`) that applies `text-overflow: ellipsis`, `overflow: hidden`, and `white-space: nowrap` to wrapped cells (`title`, `summary`, `details`, `notes`) only when content-sized mode is toggled OFF, fixing a slice cut at both edges while leaving active cell editors and content-sized mode unaffected.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E tests, desktop and mobile screenshots, dark and light themes, and independent blind visual review) -> L3 required (ticket ACs).

## Deltas from ticket

- **Fictional SaaS support data (RA-1)**: Replaced random filler and engine defect text with 10,000 deterministic support-ticket records across 8 topic areas (Billing and invoices, Account sign-in, Data exports, Email notifications, Team invitations, Subscription management, File uploads, Account preferences), 16 coherent scenarios, and 3 length tiers. Generic fictional owner names (`Alex`, `Blake`, `Casey`, `Dana`, `Jordan`, `Morgan`, `Riley`, `Sam`) and support-desk notes replace engine/maintainer names.
- **Spec decoupling (RA-2)**: Removed `SCENARIO_MAP` and local copies of `COUNTRIES`, `OWNERS`, `STATUSES` from `ContentSizedRowsExample.spec.mjs`. Preserved full-dataset fingerprint verification across reloads, scalar types validation, and sentence-shape checks.
- **Visible proof line caption**: Added an example-scoped `Label` component (`content-sized-rows-caption`) situated directly below the top control toolbar. Displays `"10,000 rows, each as tall as its text."` when content-sized mode is active, and dynamically updates to `"Fixed-height rows clip overflowing text."` when toggled off. Sized and styled with `opacity: 0.75` for immediate visibility on both 1440×900 and 390×844 viewports without horizontal overflow.
- **Fixed-height CSS polish (RA-3)**: Added example-scoped `resources/css/src/examples/grid/contentSizedRows/MainContainer.css` and `content-sized-rows-fixed` class toggle on the grid container. When fixed-height mode is toggled OFF, cells in the 4 wrapped columns truncate cleanly with ellipsis and `line-height: 27px`, fixing a slice cut at both edges, not text overflowing into adjacent rows, while keeping the `:not(:has(.neo-grid-editor))` cell editor fully functional.
- **Theme initialization**: Updated `examples/grid/contentSizedRows/app.mjs` to pass `theme:` directly to `MainContainer` so that URL query parameters (`?theme=neo-theme-light` / `neo-theme-dark`) take immediate effect on bootstrap.
- **Timing measurement honesty**: Updated double-rAF measurement annotation in `ContentSizedRowsExample.spec.mjs` to explicitly describe timing as a paint-opportunity proxy (`jump-to-row-9000-paint-opportunity-ms`) with strict timestamp finiteness and chronological ordering assertions.

## Test Evidence

### Cold look

Independent visual review conducted with Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking), acting solely as an external visual reader without implementation or session context, comparing 4 unlabelled before/after pairs with randomized A/B assignments:

| Configuration | Mode | Baseline (Before) | Refined (After) | Disposition |
|---|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| **Desktop (1440 × 900)** | Content-sized ON | 5 / 10 | **8 / 10** | Visually Better (+3.0) |
| **Mobile (390 × 844)** | Content-sized ON | 5 / 10 | **8 / 10** | Visually Better (+3.0) |
| **Desktop (1440 × 900)** | Fixed-height OFF | 2 / 10 | **9 / 10** | Visually Better (+7.0, reference-quality ellipsis truncation) |
| **Mobile (390 × 844)** | Fixed-height OFF | 2 / 10 | **9 / 10** | Visually Better (+7.0, reference-quality ellipsis truncation) |

#### Reviewer Observations
- **Desktop ON**: Meaningful SaaS support prose is immediately legible and engaging. Subtitle ("10,000 rows, each as tall as its text.") clearly communicates mode behavior. Multi-line wrapping scales cleanly with content depth.
- **Mobile ON**: Responsive two-column layout (Title + Notes) with natural line wrapping and visible subtitle. Clean layout with correct overflow handling.
- **Desktop OFF**: Baseline suffered from catastrophic inter-row text bleed across all rows (scored 2/10). Refined state implements clean single-line ellipsis truncation with uniform row height and clear caption ("Fixed-height rows clip overflowing text.") (scored 9/10).
- **Mobile OFF**: Baseline exhibited severe character collisions across all rows (scored 2/10). Refined state delivers reference-quality render (scored 9/10) with crisp single-line ellipsis truncation on both columns.
